System

Safe hubs, roads, boats and paid fast travel

Long-distance traversal uses authored roads/gates/boats and later unlocked safe-hub travel. Fast travel is a validated zone-transfer request with optional cost, not a client teleport to an arbitrary map coordinate.

Scope and player interaction

Long-distance traversal uses authored roads/gates/boats and later unlocked safe-hub travel. Fast travel is a validated zone-transfer request with optional cost, not a client teleport to an arbitrary map coordinate.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase20committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

HubLocked → HubUnlocked → QuoteReady → PaymentReserved → TransferPending → Arrived → Compensating

WBP_Map observes results from URPGFastTravelComponent. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_TravelHub_Hearthford. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
HubId/ZoneId/EntranceId: registered safe destination
UnlockedHubIds: durable discovery/quest entitlement
TravelQuoteId and Cost: bounded integer, versioned
TravelPaymentId: linked to TransferId and compensation policy
Eligibility: not in combat/dead/trading/gathering, source service context valid

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGFastTravelComponentImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_MapLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
UnlockTravelHub(CommandId, VerifiedDiscovery) -> Unlocked|AlreadyKnown
QuoteFastTravel(SourceHub, DestinationHub) -> Quote|HubLocked
ConfirmFastTravel(CommandId, QuoteId) -> TransferStarted|Rejected
ResolveTravelPayment(TransferId, Outcome) -> Captured|Refunded|AlreadyResolved

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Player unlocks a safe hub through verified discovery/quest and sees it on the map.
  2. At an authorized travel service, select another unlocked hub and receive a quote with destination/cost.
  3. Backend reserves or escrows payment linked to a new TransferId while validating eligibility/capacity; do not charge repeatedly on every connection retry.
  4. Use the same signed-ticket/session-fenced zone handoff as road gates. A boat can use this transfer with authored departure presentation, not real vehicle simulation initially.
  5. Capture cost on the declared successful handoff milestone; definitive failed reservation/transfer triggers a once-only refund/escrow release. Unknown outcomes reconcile first.
  6. On arrival spawn at registered safe entrance and clear old map/NPC contexts.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Author hub definitions for Hearthford and Kestrel shelter, with exact entrance IDs and unlock conditions.
  2. Add map marker actions and travel NPC/boat interaction; route to URPGFastTravelComponent.
  3. Extend backend transfer record with payment linkage/terminal compensation state.
  4. Reopen zone transfer recovery to distinguish unknown from definitive failure before refunding.
  5. Test full destination, expired ticket, payment response loss and arrival acknowledgement loss.

Reopen Phase20 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_Rillmere / Hub_Hearthford / Hub_Kestrel. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Locked hub -> HubLocked, no reservation or charge.
Transfer succeeds but ack lost -> receipt reconciliation captures once; no free duplicate refund.
Reservation definitively fails -> no charge or one escrow release.
Client requests coordinates/map path -> InvalidDestination; only catalog IDs allowed.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

First fast travel may be free for simpler proof, then add a modest fixed price. Roads remain meaningful; mounts and seamless world travel are separate systems.

Trace travel payment and TransferId together. UI explains cost/refund/pending state and provides accessible destination list navigation.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
